prompt: Build an FAQ section where the user clicks a question and it expands to reveal the answer below it. Several questions should be grouped together.

samples.response:
Frequently Asked Questions

Click "Forgot password" on the login screen and follow the email link to set a new one.

Go to "My Orders" and open the order you want. The latest status appears at the top.

You can return most items within 30 days of delivery, as long as they are unused.

Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. Delivery times vary by destination.

<bl-accordion-group multiple>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I reset my password?">
    Go to the login page and choose "Forgot password". We will email you a secure link.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="Can I change my shipping address after ordering?">
    Yes, as long as the order has not been shipped yet. Open the order and edit the address.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="What is your return policy?">
    You have 30 days from delivery to return unused items in their original packaging.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How long does standard delivery take?">
    Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days depending on your location.
  </bl-accordion>
</bl-accordion-group>

<bl-accordion-group>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I create an account?" icon="info">
    Click the "Sign up" button in the top-right corner, enter your email and a secure password, then verify your email address to activate your account.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How can I reset my password?" icon="info">
    Use the "Forgot password" link on the login page. We will send you a reset link valid for 24 hours. Follow it and choose a new password.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="Is my payment information safe?" icon="info">
    Yes. All payments are processed over an encrypted connection and your card details are never stored on our servers.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="Can I change or cancel my order?" icon="info">
    You can change the delivery address and cancel an order within the first 30 minutes after placing it, from the order summary page.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I contact support?" icon="info" open>
    Open the help center and choose "Contact Support". You can also reach us by email at support@example.com, available 24/7.
  </bl-accordion>
</bl-accordion-group>
